text:
maya: Quick check — for the upcoming console observability phase gate (tomorrow EOD), can owners confirm the dashboard metrics retention bump (+30 days) and tracing hook changes are safe to go? I want to ensure we won't spike storage costs or lose alert fidelity.

sam: I'm the owner for the dashboard dashboards team. PR is up: https://git.company/pr/4821 — retention config + migration script. CI passed locally but one integration test failed in staging (flaky sampler).

jin: FYI infra needs to flip the S3 lifecycle rule and the TTL index in metrics-store. I opened infra ticket INF-913 and tagged eng-infra. Without that, migration will keep data indefinitely.

lia: On runbooks: we'll need to add a rollback step and a short blameless note for paging on high ingest. I'll draft and put it in the runbook repo by noon.

sam: @jin do you know if infra can do the lifecycle change before the gate? If not, we should gate retention bump and ship tracing hooks only.

ops-bot: CI: staging-e2e #4821 — 1 failed, 12 passed. Failed job: sampler-flaky-test. Logs: https://ci.company/logs/4821

jin: I pinged eng-infra in their channel — they said earliest window is today 18:30 PT. That is after our current canary start. We have two options: delay retention bump to next window or pause canary until lifecycle change completes.

maya: Thanks. Proposal: proceed with tracing hooks and error analysis views in canary, delay retention bump to the infra window. Can dashboard team prepare migration so it's ready to flip once infra confirms?

sam: Ack — will mark retention change as HOLD in the rollout config and re-run canary with tracing only. I'll also add a quick test to catch sampler flakiness.

lia: I'll add rollback steps and an alert tweak to avoid noisy pages during the sampler test.

maya: Quick asks: (1) sam — @ you for CR review after you push the sampler test fix (should be small). (2) jin — confirm infra window once they acknowledge (drop a timestamp). (3) @all — if anyone expects cost impact > 5% on monthly storage after the bump, flag it now.

sam: Will do CR ping when ready :+1:

jin: infra confirmed window: 2026-03-17T18:30:00Z. I'll update the ticket.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary start (tracing-only) scheduled at 2468900500.

maya: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll close this thread once CR is merged and infra ticket updated.

sam: One more note — tagging @security for audit of retention policy change; we updated the data-flow doc in PR.

lia: Noted, I'll add the audit checklist item to runbook.

maya: Thanks — moving to ACTIONS: sam (CR + test), jin (infra confirmation), lia (runbook + audit), maya (gate final).
